title: 田畑と里山
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: ONE original square environment illustration for a Japanese creative website's scene chooser. Complete actual illustrated scenery, refined professional background artwork with convincing depth, natural material texture, soft neutral environmental light, restrained colour and delicate lines. Show specified scene clearly, no title-only placeholder. Environment fills image; foreground/middle/background connected in consistent perspective. No people, faces or human-shaped shadows, no artist references, no copying existing artworks, no lantern, fantasy glow, logos, text/labels, collage or multi-panel contact sheet. Exactly one finished image. Scene: An original Japanese countryside place showing CULTIVATED FIELDS and nearby low satoyama hills. Slightly elevated field-edge view in late summer daylight. Foreground orderly vegetable rows and narrow irrigation channels, middle ground alternating rice fields and a winding farm track, one small timber farm shed at edge, low wooded hills background. Vegetables and rice form distinct agricultural textures; natural soil and water surfaces. Not mountain lake, not seaside, not a village street. No workers, machines or crowds.
processing: Original generated resolution kept; RGB JPEG q85 encoding only

visualQA.method: Individual review of the full generated output; file checks are separate from visual scene assessment.
visualQA.observations: 前景の野菜畑の畝と水路、中景の田畑、奥の低い樹林の丘が見える。水田中心の里山と田園風景とは異なる農地の記録で、人物や文字はない。
